free_tier.stated: 15 GB of free transfer every month plus 5 days of free storage per package. Credit card with a $10 pre-authorisation required at signup.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: request-rate/quota: 15 GB transfer per calendar month; retention: 5 days free storage per file, then per-GB storage billing; per-GB egress $0.25 after the allowance

egress.terms: Metered after the free allowance: $0.25/GB pay-as-you-go, charged on *egress* ('when a file exits our network, either as a download to a machine or an upload to connected storage, we apply an egress fee per gigabyte').

interface_detail: rest (MASV API / desktop app / S3-adjacent cloud integrations)
tooling: official MASV desktop app + API; cloud integrations push to S3/GCS/Azure
chaining: 15 GB/month free credit x unlimited free accounts x a valid card each; the card pre-auth is the anti-multiplication gate. Even at 100 accounts that is 1.5 TB/month of *transfer*, not storage, and every byte over 15 GB bills at $0.25/GB.
